objects.name: xp_src
objects.ddl: CREATE DATABASE `xp_src` /*!40100 DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin */ /*!80016 DEFAULT ENCRYPTION='N' */

objects.name: a_lines
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `a_lines` (
  `order_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `line` int NOT NULL,
  `amount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`order_id`,`line`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_lines_order` FOREIGN KEY (`order_id`) REFERENCES `orders` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: checks
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `checks` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `qty` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `price` decimal(8,2) DEFAULT ((0.5 * 2)),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `k_inv` (`qty`) /*!80000 INVISIBLE */,
  KEY `k_fn` (((`qty` * 2))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_qty` CHECK ((`qty` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: customers
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `customers` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `email` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL COMMENT 'login ação',
  `name` varchar(80) CHARACTER SET latin1 COLLATE latin1_swedish_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `referrer_id` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `created` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '0000-00-00 00:00:00',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_email` (`email`),
  KEY `k_ref` (`referrer_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_referrer` FOREIGN KEY (`referrer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin COMMENT='Customer accounts; ünïcode'

objects.name: departments
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `departments` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `head_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `k_head` (`head_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_dept_head` FOREIGN KEY (`head_id`) REFERENCES `employees` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: employees
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `employees` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `dept_id` int NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `k_dept` (`dept_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_emp_dept` FOREIGN KEY (`dept_id`) REFERENCES `departments` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: gen
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `gen` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `a` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `b` int GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((`a` * 2)) VIRTUAL,
  `c` int GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((`a` + 1)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: js
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `js` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `doc` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `tags` set('x','y') COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: logs
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `logs` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `at` date NOT NULL,
  `msg` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`,`at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
/*!50100 PARTITION BY RANGE (year(`at`))
(PARTITION p2025 VALUES LESS THAN (2026) ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION pmax VALUES LESS THAN MAXVALUE ENGINE = InnoDB) */

objects.name: nopk
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `nopk` (
  `my_row_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT /*!80023 INVISIBLE */,
  `a` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `b` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`my_row_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: orders
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `orders` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `customer_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `total` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `note` text COLLATE utf8mb4_bin,
  `currency` char(3) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `k_customer` (`customer_id`),
  FULLTEXT KEY `ft_note` (`note`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_orders_customer` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: plain_myisam
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `plain_myisam` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `txt` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: v_big
objects.ddl: CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`%` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `xp_src`.`v_big` AS select `xp_src`.`v_orders`.`id` AS `id`,`xp_src`.`v_orders`.`email` AS `email` from `xp_src`.`v_orders` where (`xp_src`.`v_orders`.`total` > 1000)

objects.name: v_bigger
objects.ddl: CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`%` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `xp_src`.`v_bigger` AS select `xp_src`.`b`.`id` AS `id` from (`xp_src`.`v_big` `b` join `xp_src`.`v_orders` `o` on((`xp_src`.`o`.`id` = `xp_src`.`b`.`id`)))

objects.name: v_orders
objects.ddl: CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`%` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `xp_src`.`v_orders` AS select `o`.`id` AS `id`,`c`.`email` AS `email`,`o`.`total` AS `total`,`f_double`(`o`.`total`) AS `dbl` from (`xp_src`.`orders` `o` join `xp_src`.`customers` `c` on((`c`.`id` = `o`.`customer_id`))) where (`o`.`total` > 10)

objects.name: p_touch
f_double
objects.ddl:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`%` FUNCTION `f_double`(x INT) RETURNS int
    DETERMINISTIC
RETURN x * 2

objects.name: trg_au
objects.ddl: CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`%` TRIGGER `trg_au` AFTER UPDATE ON `customers` FOR EACH ROW SET @last = "changed"

objects.name: trg_bi
objects.ddl: CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`%` TRIGGER `trg_bi` BEFORE INSERT ON `orders` FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.total = ROUND(NEW.total, 2)

objects.name: trg_bi0
objects.ddl: CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`%` TRIGGER `trg_bi0` BEFORE INSERT ON `orders` FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.currency = UPPER(NEW.currency)

objects.name: ev_cleanup
objects.ddl: CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`%` EVENT `ev_cleanup` ON SCHEDULE EVERY 2 DAY STARTS '2030-01-01 00:00:00' ON COMPLETION PRESERVE DISABLE DO DELETE FROM logs WHERE at < '2000-01-01'
